The breadth and depth of their solutions allowed us to pick a single supplier and enabled us to move faster, unlocking our speed to market.” The slide identifies the delivered scope as cloud POS, indoor and outdoor kiosks, drive-thru digital menu boards, and an integrated unified commerce platform.
extracted_claims: Josh Wesolowski publicly endorsed Global Payments following CosMc’s comprehensive supplier-selection process.
Josh stated that the breadth and depth of Global Payments solutions enabled CosMc’s to select a single supplier.
Josh stated that the solution enabled CosMc’s to move faster and improve speed to market.
The referenced CosMc’s scope included cloud POS, kiosks, drive-thru digital menu boards, and an integrated unified commerce platform.
Josh has direct prior experience with Global Payments/Genius in a McDonald’s-affiliated operating concept.
limitations: The quote is strong evidence of prior positive experience and supports treating Josh as at least a coach candidate. It does not by itself confirm current sponsorship, political influence, access, or willingness to champion a McDonald’s-system deployment; champion status remains a hypothesis to test.

McDonald's reports standardized POS across nearly all markets, Google Edge deployed to thousands of restaurants in seven major markets, and a common restaurant-data layer spanning more than 46,000 restaurants.
McDonald's says U.S. Google Edge infrastructure deployment begins in 2027.
Announced ArchIQ use cases include Archy drive-thru voice AI, BLE-tag automated inventory, connected equipment/computer vision, and order-accuracy verification.
